document_notes: Page 114 contains entries 668 to 673. Only entry 668 is relevant to the PROVINCIA corpus as it explicitly discusses a governorship with the formula 'legatum Aug. pr. pr. Syriae'.

entries.relevance_notes: The entry explicitly discusses Marcus Annius Libo as 'legatum Aug. pr. pr. Syriae' during the Parthian War under Marcus Aurelius and Lucius Verus.

segments.lemma: M. ANNIVS LIBO, M. f. Gal(eria)
segments.identification_and_sources: nominatur inter testes senatus consulti de Cyzicenis facti sub Antonino Pio III 7060 = D. 7190.
segments.offices_and_career: Filius sine dubio M. Annii Libonis consulis a. 128; idem videtur Libo patruelis imperatoris Marci ab eo temporibus belli Parthici legatus in Syriam missus, qui ibi periit subito morbo notis prope veneni existentibus (c. a. 163) vita Veri 9, 2.
segments.governorship_attestation: Libonem legatum Aug. pr. pr. Syriae fuisse putaverim; quod si recte ponitur antea consul (suff. a. inc.) fuerit necesse est.
segments.family_and_social_relations: Libonis uxorem invito Marco Verus dedit Agaclyto liberto ib. 9, 3. — Fortasse filius eius M. Annius Sabinus Libo, curator Lavinii. Nepos Libonis huius videtur M. Annius Flavius Libo consul a. 204.
segments.prosopographical_commentary: The author identifies him as the cousin (patruelis) of Emperor Marcus Aurelius, sent to Syria during the Parthian War, where he died under suspicious circumstances (suspected poisoning).
segments.bibliography_or_cross_references: CIL III 7060 = D. 7190. HA, Vita Veri 9, 2; 9, 3. Cf. M. Annius Flavius Libo.

notes: Cousin of Marcus Aurelius, died in Syria c. 163 AD.
